title: Live Viewer admin REST contract — the tenant-scoped API the Dashboard SPA depends on
contract-package: Herald.RestApi.Contracts (LiveViewer/*.cs) — ILiveViewerAdminApi + the Level/Category/Enricher DTOs. The wire shape is what the SPA depends on; the package is where the shape is defined.

scope.statement: The Live Viewer admin family is the tenant-scoped REST surface the Dashboard SPA reads to hydrate its panels and writes to program the pipeline live. Every route is scoped to one tenant and one pipeline: `/api/tenants/{tenantId}/pipelines/{pipelineId}/...`. The family covers a read snapshot (`GET .../live-viewer`), the level / category / enricher mutation panels, the configured-sink instance list, and the SSE config-change channel that tells other tabs to re-hydrate after a peer made a change.
in-scope: The read snapshot: GET /live-viewer returns a LiveViewerState the SPA hydrates its Pinia stores from on boot
Per-level admin: style, minimum-level floor, flight-recorder threshold, reorder, create, delete
Per-category admin: style, active toggle, create, delete
Per-enricher admin: style, active toggle, create, delete, opaque kind-config
The configured-sink instance list: GET /sinks (projected from the bootstrap), plus the sink mutation family
The SSE config-change channel: a cross-tab awareness hint, not a state-delivery channel
out-of-scope: Focus-lane assignment (FOCUS 1 / FOCUS 2 triangles) and banding bucket size — operator-local, persisted in browser localStorage only; no server route exists in this Contracts version (see live-viewer-port-plan §§3.7, 3.9, wave-1 ratification D2/D3)
The live log feed itself — that arrives on the per-tenant event stream (GET /api/tenants/{tenantId}/events/stream), a separate channel from config-change
Pipeline identity CRUD (create/delete whole pipelines) — that is the IPipelineAdminApi family, not this one
Sink download/install (NuGet pull) — a separate concern from configuring an already-loaded sink (project_sink_catalog_model)

auth.read-capability: ReadTenant — a read-only principal that can list pipelines can also hydrate their Live Viewer state
auth.write-capability: WriteTenant — the same capability IPipelineAdminApi.UpdateAsync uses; no new capability bit was introduced
auth.scoping: Every capability check is scoped to the route's tenant. A principal scoped to a different tenant is rejected with HTTP 403.
auth.demo-note: The DemoApp no-auth path injects a static principal granted system-administer plus every Pro/Enterprise capability, so the demo exercises the full write surface against the FakeServer. Production hosts never run in this mode; the startup banner says so.

timing-contract: PATCH-200 means accepted-and-queryable: by the time a 2xx response reaches the caller, a follow-up GET against the same pipeline reflects the new state. There is no convergence-polling requirement and no 'wait for the SSE event' requirement for the originating caller. Every PATCH is idempotent at the field level — sending the same payload twice produces the same result.

shared-shapes.name: LiveViewerState
shared-shapes.summary: The per-pipeline snapshot GET /live-viewer returns. The read-side companion to the mutation surface. Carries each resource family with its current contents AND the list ETag at the moment of the read, so a caller that then issues a reorder/create/delete can pass the ETag to participate in the optimistic-concurrency check.

fields.name: levelsETag
fields.notes: List-version token for the levels list.

fields.name: categories
fields.notes: Current category list. Herald.OSS ships none; the panel fills from the live feed.

fields.name: enrichers
fields.notes: Current enricher panel, keyed by emitted FIELD name (snake_case), not class name.

fields.name: minLevelPriority
fields.notes: Minimum-visible-level floor as a 1-based priority. Null = no floor; accept every level emitted.

fields.name: flightRecorderPresent
fields.notes: True iff a flightRecorder logger entry exists in the bootstrap loggers[]. Distinct from Enabled: 'FR removed' (Present=false) and 'FR present but disarmed' (Present=true, Enabled=false) are distinguishable on the wire. Trailing + defaulted false for back-compat.

fields.name: id
fields.notes: Stable per-pipeline level id. For seeded levels the id IS the name (NAME-bound identity).

fields.name: priority
fields.notes: Position in the level list, 1..N, contiguous and unique.

shared-shapes.name: LevelStyle / CategoryStyle / EnricherStyle
shared-shapes.summary: Rendering style for a token in the feed. Three distinct types with the identical shape, kept separate so per-level / per-category / per-enricher styles cannot be mixed at the call boundary.

fields.name: bg
fields.notes: Optional background hex; null leaves the row/token background unchanged.

fields.name: active
fields.notes: Whether the category contributes to the live feed.

shared-shapes.name: EnricherDto
shared-shapes.summary: One per-pipeline enricher panel row, keyed by emitted FIELD name (snake_case), not by the Core class name. One class can emit several fields, so the panel is per-field.

fields.name: id
fields.notes: The snake field-name; equals the SSE enrichers{} key and the SPA tint-match id — one id end to end.

fields.name: active
fields.notes: Whether the enricher contributes to pipeline events.

shared-shapes.name: Pipeline
shared-shapes.summary: Every mutating call returns the post-mutation Pipeline envelope (the same shape IPipelineAdminApi uses) so the caller can update its modified-at timestamp without a follow-up GET.

fields.name: (IPipelineAdminApi.Pipeline)
fields.notes: Canonical pipeline envelope; the mutation routes return this rather than the LiveViewerState. Re-hydrate via GET /live-viewer when the full snapshot is needed.

shared-shapes.name: ETag
shared-shapes.summary: List-version token for optimistic concurrency. ETag.Unconditional means 'no If-Match precondition'.

fields.name: value
fields.notes: Opaque token. Pass the value observed on the hydrating GET into a reorder/delete request to participate in the concurrency check.

routes.summary: Returns the per-pipeline LiveViewerState snapshot — levels, categories, enrichers, list ETags, minimum-level floor, and flight-recorder config. The SPA's boot-time hydration call, and the call it repeats after the SSE config-change channel signals a peer mutated state.

status-codes.meaning: Principal scoped to a different tenant.

routes.notes: Read-only — gates on ReadTenant. Repeated calls between mutations return byte-identical state. This is the route whose absence caused the DemoApp `HTTP 404` banner before the FakeServer became the demo (see planning record demoapp-jsx-server-api-gap).

routes.summary: Replaces the entire rendering style for one level. Fired by StyleDialog Save in the Levels drawer.

status-codes.meaning: Pipeline or level does not exist.

routes.summary: Sets the minimum-visible-level floor. Fired by clicking the level number in the Levels drawer set-mode.

status-codes.meaning: Priority outside the pipeline's level-priority range (ValidationException).

routes.notes: Priority = null clears the floor so the pipeline accepts every level it emits.

routes.summary: Sets the flight-recorder threshold priority and armed/disarmed state. Fired by the FR half of the split level-number button.

status-codes.meaning: Priority below the current minimum-visible-level — FR cannot be more permissive than MIN (§3.3).

routes.notes: FR presence is governed by loggers[], not by this PATCH — a disarm (Enabled=false) keeps the entry so the operator's level pick survives the toggle.

routes.summary: Replaces the level priority ordering. Server renumbers 1..N from the supplied id sequence. Fired by drag-handle drop.

status-codes.meaning: Supplied id set does not match the pipeline's level set (missing or unknown ids).
ExpectedETag does not match the current level-list ETag (another writer moved the list).

routes.summary: Creates a new custom level. Fired by ListEditorDialog Add.
routes.request-shape: CreateLevelRequest { Name: string, Style: LevelStyle, InsertAtPriority: int? }

status-codes.meaning: InsertAtPriority targets an occupied slot — caller shifts via reorder or omits the slot to append (ValidationException).

routes.summary: Removes a custom level. Fired by ListEditorDialog Remove.
routes.request-shape: DeleteLevelRequest { ExpectedETag: ETag } — OPTIONAL body; a bodyless DELETE is unconditional

status-codes.meaning: Deleted (or already absent — idempotent on the resource).
ExpectedETag supplied and does not match the current level-list ETag.

routes.notes: The If-Match precondition is opt-in (RFC 9110 §13.1.1): send an ETag for optimistic-concurrency 409s; omit the body for an unconditional delete. Deleting an unknown id is a success, not a 404.

routes.summary: Replaces the rendering style for one category.

status-codes.meaning: Pipeline or category does not exist.

routes.summary: Toggles whether a category contributes to the live feed.

status-codes.meaning: Pipeline or category does not exist.

routes.request-shape: CreateCategoryRequest { Name: string, Style: CategoryStyle, Active: bool = true }

status-codes.meaning: ExpectedETag does not match the current category-list ETag.

routes.summary: Replaces the rendering style for one enricher.

status-codes.meaning: Pipeline or enricher does not exist.

routes.summary: Toggles whether an enricher contributes to pipeline events.

status-codes.meaning: Pipeline or enricher does not exist.

routes.request-shape: CreateEnricherRequest { Name: string, Style: EnricherStyle, Active: bool = true }

status-codes.meaning: ExpectedETag does not match the current enricher-list ETag.

routes.summary: Updates enricher-kind-specific configuration. The body is opaque JSON; the shape contract belongs to the enricher implementation, not the Contracts package.

status-codes.meaning: ServerPro's enricher loader rejected the JSON shape (ValidationException). ServerOSS treats the body as opaque and round-trips it without schema validation.
Pipeline or enricher does not exist.

routes.summary: Lists the configured-sink instances attached to the pipeline. The Dashboard's SinksLane hydrates from this. Distinct from GET /api/sinks, which lists what sink KINDS are available.

status-codes.meaning: Instance list (empty array when the pipeline has no sinks — a normal state).
Pipeline does not exist — a fetch error, distinct from 'no sinks'.

routes.notes: Bootstrap-authoritative: the instance list is PROJECTED from the pipeline's bootstrap.sinks[] through BootstrapSinkCodec on every read, not served from a store. A hand-edited bootstrap + restart reflects here with zero store-vs-bootstrap drift. runState (live|test|disabled) rides through verbatim. The create/update/delete sink mutations live in a sibling FakeServer-local family (POST/PUT/DELETE .../sinks, GET .../sinks/editable-config); they are NOT part of the Contracts ILiveViewerAdminApi interface.

channels.purpose: Published after every successful ILiveViewerAdminApi mutation. A cross-tab and cross-operator AWARENESS hint, not a state-delivery channel. Tabs treat it as a signal to re-hydrate the affected slice via GET /live-viewer; they do NOT apply state from the payload (the GET against the canonical envelope is authoritative). The originating tab already has the authoritative state from its own PATCH-200, so it can drop events whose OriginToken matches its own token.

envelope-fields.name: resourceId
envelope-fields.notes: The specific resource id; null for list-scoped verbs (reorder, set-min, set-flight-recorder).

envelope-fields.name: etag
envelope-fields.notes: List-version token AFTER the mutation, for create/delete/reorder. Null on per-resource style/active/config mutations that don't bump the list ETag. Lets the SPA refresh its If-Match cache without an extra GET.

envelope-fields.name: originToken
envelope-fields.notes: Per-tab origin token captured from the X-Herald-Origin-Tab request header at broadcast time. Null when the mutation arrived without the header (server-issued change, batch job, external tool). The originating tab drops events whose token matches its own — self-echo dedup.

consumers.name: Dashboard SPA (the JSX Live Viewer)
consumers.implementation: Herald.RestApi.FakeServer (the FakeServer honors the full wire shape end to end)
consumers.notes: The SPA's api-client targets this exact route family. Against the FakeServer every route works: hydrate, mutate, re-hydrate, live feed.

consumers.name: Herald.DemoApp (PackageId Herald.DemoApp, v0.1.0-alpha.1)
consumers.implementation: Herald.RestApi.FakeServer sample (samples/DemoApp) — this IS the public demo per the 2026-05-28 decision
consumers.notes: Runs a real Herald.OSS pipeline over synthetic events, serves the JSX SPA, and honors this contract against the FakeServer stores. NOT the umbrella Modules/DemoApp (which wraps Herald.Server and 404s on this family).

consumers.name: Herald.RestApi.Host
consumers.implementation: implemented-reference-host — honors the route shapes over InMemoryLiveViewerAdmin
consumers.notes: Conformance/reference host. In-memory, no live pipeline, does not serve the SPA, no demo seed. Proves the wire shape; does not back it with a real pipeline.

consumers.name: Herald.Server (Modules/Server)
consumers.implementation: DOES NOT implement this family — speaks the legacy flat API (/api/config/..., /api/pipeline/{name}/..., /api/levels) only
consumers.notes: The umbrella Modules/DemoApp wraps this server, which is why that package 404s on /live-viewer. Binding ILiveViewerAdminApi over Herald.Server's real pipeline is the open production gap (issue #38).

implementation-gap: The contract is fully honored by the FakeServer (the public demo) and by the in-memory reference host. It is NOT yet bound to a real Herald.Server pipeline. Issue #38 (Glenn D3) is the open production binding: implement ILiveViewerAdminApi over the live pipeline and host the tenant-scoped family in Herald.ServerOSS / a real server. The underlying pipeline operations already exist on HeraldManagementApi (GetLevelStyles, GetCategoryStyles, GetCustomLevels, SetMinimumLevel, SetFlightRecorderConfig, enricher add/remove) — the missing piece is the tenant-scoped routing shell plus the LiveViewerState mapping, not the pipeline operations themselves. See the planning record demoapp-jsx-server-api-gap for the full disposition.
